physics-killer-06.title: Ing bidang datar tanpa
physics-killer-06.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-06.material: Ing bidang datar tanpa gesekan, benda A massa $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ obah kanthi $6\,\mathrm{m/s}$ lan nabrak benda B massa $4\,\mathrm{kg}$ sing awale meneng, sakwise kuwi loro benda nempel lan obah bebarengan. Yen wektu tumbukan $0.05\,\mathrm{s}$, pasangan endi sing bener kanthi urutan nuduhake kacepetan loro benda sakwise tumbukan lan gedhene gaya rata-rata sing ditampa B sajrone tumbukan?
physics-killer-06.s.s1.prompt: Ing bidang datar tanpa gesekan, benda A massa $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ obah kanthi $6\,\mathrm{m/s}$ lan nabrak benda B massa $4\,\mathrm{kg}$ sing awale meneng, sakwise kuwi loro benda nempel lan obah bebarengan. Yen wektu tumbukan $0.05\,\mathrm{s}$, pasangan endi sing bener kanthi urutan nuduhake kacepetan loro benda sakwise tumbukan lan gedhene gaya rata-rata sing ditampa B sajrone tumbukan?
physics-killer-06.s.s1.explain: Kekekalan momentum: $2\cdot6=(2+4)v\Rightarrow v=2\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Owah momentum B $\Delta p_B=4\cdot2-0=8\,\mathrm{kg\cdot m/s}$, mula $F_{avg}=\dfrac{8}{0.05}=160\,\mathrm{N}$. (Owah momentum A $2(2-6)=-8$ gedhene padha, mula konsisten.) Yen mung nganggo $m_A$ tinimbang massa gabungan, $v=3\,\mathrm{m/s}$ dadi jawaban salah ①, yen momentum wiwitan A $12$ dienggo ngitung gaya dadi $240\,\mathrm{N}$ (jawaban salah ②), lan yen $v_B=4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ saka tumbukan lenting dienggo dadi jawaban salah ③.
